reference: The AA23-165A Table 4 caption lists Chocolatey as a tool used by LockBit affiliates. The selected advisory row maps its reported use to T1072 (Software Deployment Tools). The direct, active mitigates relationships in Enterprise ATT&CK 17.1 connect this technique to: M1015 (Active Directory Configuration), M1017 (User Training), M1018 (User Account Management), M1026 (Privileged Account Management), M1027 (Password Policies), M1029 (Remote Data Storage), M1030 (Network Segmentation), M1032 (Multi-factor Authentication), M1033 (Limit Software Installation), M1051 (Update Software). These are reference mitigation associations, not incident-specific proof of effectiveness.
